introHtml: 14 oz Moscow mule mugs hit the sweet spot between a standard 16 oz mug and a smaller shot glass, making them ideal for serving cocktails or non-alcoholic beverages at corporate events and branded bars. Their copper finish provides a classic look that stands out in photos, while the 14 oz capacity offers a generous pour without excessive weight. Decorate with your logo using etching or screen printing for a polished, professional result that guests will reuse.
